facts.text: "Chuck, eat your stew while it is hot. After supper we find out how a patient walks out of a locked room."
facts.why: Teddy never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Teddy Daniels, so it reads as a film line. His famous last line is about the monster and the good man.
facts.fix: Which would be worse? To live as a monster, or to die as a good man?
